backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining products, carts, orders, user profiles, and admin authorization with access control and admin key management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented login‑related features, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend files and pages across customer and admin areas.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet placeholder for global frontend styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routing, auth guards, profile setup flow, and query client setup.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Admin dialog showing full order details including status, amounts, timestamps, customer info, and items.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access-denied message with login method info and a button redirecting users to the login page.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and auto-recovery for authentication errors.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for collecting and saving user profile details with validation and status feedback.
frontend/src/components/catalog/Categori: Shows a mixed category section with a featured grid, carousel, and selection highlighting using category-specific styles.
frontend/src/components/catalog/category: Maps category names to Lucide icons and provides a helper to fetch the appropriate icon.
frontend/src/components/hero/Hero3D.tsx: Implements animated 3D grocery-themed objects using react-three-fiber with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/KiranaBrandHeade: Header component with navigation, branding, cart count, login/admin actions, theme toggle, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Button toggling between light and dark themes using next‑themes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthStatus.ts: Combines Internet Identity state and backend role queries to derive authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication lifecycle, exposing identity, login/clear functions, and detailed status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects the user's reduced-motion preference and updates on system setting changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user auth, profiles, products, orders, and admin settings, wrapping backend actor calls with queries and mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and warm-themed OKLCH color variables for light and dark mode styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Renders the admin panel layout with navigation, mobile sidebar, header, and theming controls.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DashboardPage.t: Displays store metrics, order/product stats, and allows updating the bootstrap admin email.
frontend/src/pages/admin/InventoryPage.t: Empty placeholder page for future inventory management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Lists and filters orders, supports status updates, viewing details, and manual refresh.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductsPage.ts: Manages product CRUD operations, including adding, editing, deleting, and stock updates.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StaffPage.tsx: Empty placeholder for future staff management features.
frontend/src/pages/admin/SuppliersPage.t: Empty placeholder for supplier management content.
frontend/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Login page implementing internet identity login plus placeholder email/password and OTP flows with form validation and redirects.
frontend/src/pages/customer/AboutPage.ts: Static about page describing the store, its story, and values with images and icon cards.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CartPage.tsx: Displays cart contents, allows removing items and clearing the cart, and shows totals using product and cart query hooks.
Product catalog with search, category filtering, hero section, and add‑to‑cart functionality using product and identity hooks.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CheckoutPage: Checkout form using user profile and cart data, validating input and placing an order via mutation before redirecting.
Static contact page showing store info and a non-functional message form.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CustomerLayo: Defines the main customer layout with header, routed content, and a footer containing brand info, links, and social icons.
frontend/src/pages/customer/GoalsPage.ts: Displays the store's mission and goals with cards, icons, and an illustrative image.
frontend/src/pages/customer/OrderConfirm: Shows order confirmation details, order ID, and navigation buttons for tracking or viewing orders.
frontend/src/pages/customer/OrdersPage.t: Lists the user's orders with status indicators and navigation to order details, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/customer/OrderTrackin: Fetches and displays detailed tracking information for a specific order, including status and refresh handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for getting, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, typography, container queries, and extended theme utilities.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a full‑stack kirana system with UI plans, auth requirements, data seeding, known issues, and architectural notes.
